text: Standalone local capture tool: `pnpm capture` serves UI + bridge on localhost
description: Move the capture UI out of the website into its own small app served by the bridge (one process, http://localhost:5174, Vite middleware in dev). Remove /capture from the website build. Upload target (gallery URL) + upload key are set in the capture UI settings (already exists); keys come from the deployed site's Admin → Upload keys (already exists). Reuses shared/ (geometry, image variants) and CornerEditor.

status.comment: pnpm capture serves UI + /bridge API on :5174 (Vite middleware); /capture removed from website. Verified headless 2026-11-02.
